'''Darley''' (Japanese: '''ガンモ''' ''Ganmo'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[SM118|Aiming for the Top Floor!]]''. He is one of the ninjas in the [[Kantonian Gym]], and is in charge of its second floor.

Darley presented {{Ash}} and {{ashcl}} with a banquet of food, which they proceeded to enjoy. After they finished it, Darley declared that they had all completed his task. {{an|Lillie}} was surprised that all they had to do was eat, but he explained the task was for participants to truly appreciate all that [[Malie City]] has to offer.
